recent_changes.description: Dynamic maxOutputTokens allocation based on source text length to reduce waste. Implemented compact glossary format for prompt efficiency.
Realtime Token & Cost Tracking for workspaces. Users can now see exact spending per book in the header.
Automated Title Fixer for Chinese titles. Uses ultra-cheap API calls to repair titles with remaining Chinese characters with self-correction retry.

decisions_made.decision: TITLE_RULE placement at the top of System Instruction
decisions_made.reason: AI often ignores rules buried in the middle. Putting title requirements first ensures they are treated with highest priority.

decisions_made.decision: Ultra-cheap model calls for Title Fixing
decisions_made.reason: Fixing just a title doesn't require a large context. Using minimal maxOutputTokens and specific prompts saves significantly compared to re-translating whole chapters.
